import re

content = file_content['content']
lines = content.strip().split('\n')
# Skip the first line if it's a comment
archived_songs = []
for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('#') or not line:
        continue
    # Format: "- Title by Artist1, Artist2"
    if line.startswith('- '):
        line = line[2:]
    # Split on " by " to separate title and artists
    if ' by ' in line:
        title, artists_str = line.split(' by ', 1)
        artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
        archived_songs.append({'title': title.strip(), 'artists': artists})
    else:
        # If no " by ", treat whole line as title
        archived_songs.append({'title': line, 'artists': []})

print(f"Parsed {len(archived_songs)} archived songs")
for song in archived_songs:
    print(song)

content = file_resp["content"]
lines = content.strip().split("\n")
# Skip the first line if it's a comment (# Archived Songs)
songs = []
for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith("#"):
        continue
    # Format: "- Title by Artist1, Artist2"
    if line.startswith("- "):
        line = line[2:]
    # Split on " by " to separate title and artists
    if " by " in line:
        title_part, artists_part = line.split(" by ", 1)
        title = title_part.strip()
        artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_part.split(",")]
